rule: A team must receive a warning if it adds a guest player without a guest entry form.
incident: The team added a guest player and submitted no guest entry form.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it puts a player on two match entries for the same session.
incident: The team put the same player on both of its morning match entries.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it omits the division from its league registration.
incident: The team turned in its registration with the division box empty.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it names a coach as a player on the entry list.
incident: The team entered its coach in a player slot on the entry list.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it records its away points in the home points column.
incident: The team wrote its away points in the home column of the score sheet.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it omits the winning team from a report for a match with a winner.
incident: The team filed its report for a match that ended 4 to 2 with the winner box empty.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it sends an attendance report with a head count but no player names.
incident: The team reported that seven players attended and left the names section blank.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it marks a postponed match as completed in the results log.
incident: The team marked a match as completed even though it had been postponed.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it takes more than thirty seconds to restart after a ready signal.
incident: The team waited forty-five seconds after the ready signal before restarting.

rule: A team must receive a warning if its captain calls a timeout before the second period begins.
incident: The team's captain called a timeout during the first period.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it begins its field setup before the setup window opens.
incident: The team started setting out markers two minutes before the setup window opened.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it keeps the scoring desk open after the session clock expires.
incident: The team left its scoring desk open for a minute after the clock expired.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it presents a training bib with an unreadable number at inspection.
incident: The team presented a training bib whose number had peeled off.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it brings a spare ball to inspection with the valve cap missing.
incident: The team presented a spare ball without a valve cap.

rule: A team must receive a warning if its team stopwatch fails the display check.
incident: The team's stopwatch display showed no digits during the check.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it presents a set of field markers with fewer than two corner flags.
incident: The team presented its field marker set with only one corner flag.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it tapes a notice to the painted wall of the clubhouse.
incident: The team taped its lineup notice to the painted clubhouse wall.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it uses the scorekeeper's chair for team seating.
incident: A player from the team sat in the chair reserved for the scorekeeper.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it passes its equipment over the field rope.
incident: The team handed a bag over the field rope to a teammate.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it parks its kit cart in the marked bench aisle.
incident: The team parked its cart in the marked bench aisle.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it substitutes a player while the ball is in play.
incident: The team made a substitution while the ball was in play.

rule: A team must receive a warning if its substitute takes the field without a player bib.
incident: The team's substitute entered wearing a plain shirt and no bib.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it makes a substitution during the final scheduled restart.
incident: The team changed players during the final scheduled restart.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it asks for two substitutions on one exchange card.
incident: The team listed two incoming players on a single exchange card.
